meta.name: terraform-module-library
meta.description: Build reusable Terraform modules for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI infrastructure following infrastructure-as-code best practices. Use when creating infrastructure modules, standardizing cloud provisioning, or implementing reusable IaC components.

copy.tagline: 用代码构建跨云可复用的基础设施模块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为多云环境编写可复用的Terraform模块。
copy.tagline_en: Build reusable infrastructure modules across clouds with code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're writing reusable Terraform modules for multi-cloud infrastructure.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按技能里的标准结构生成 Terraform 模块:把资源、输入变量、输出、版本约束分别放进对应文件,并附 README、示例与 Terratest 测试代码。模块面向 AWS、Azure、GCP 等云平台。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建可复用的基础设施模块、把云资源部署标准化,或实现可复用的 IaC(基础设施即代码)组件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 AWS VPC 的 Terraform 模块,按技能里的标准来。
say.note: 会生成主资源、变量和输出的拆分文件。

say.text: 把这个 VPC 模块的 vpc_id 接入 RDS 模块。
say.note: 会给出把 vpc_id 输出接到 RDS 模块的引用写法。

say.text: 给这个 VPC 模块补一个 Terratest 的 Go 测试。
say.note: 会给出能 apply 和销毁的测试代码。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude writes Terraform modules using the skill's standard structure: resources, inputs, outputs, and provider versions each in their own file, plus README, examples, and Terratest tests. For AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when users ask to create reusable infrastructure modules, standardize cloud resource deployment, or implement reusable infrastructure-as-code components.

say_en.text: Write an AWS VPC Terraform module following the skill's standard.
say_en.note: Produces separate files for resources, variables, and outputs.

say_en.text: Wire this VPC module's vpc_id into an RDS module.
say_en.note: Shows the composition snippet wiring vpc_id to the RDS module.

say_en.text: Add a Terratest Go test for this VPC module.
say_en.note: Gives a Terratest with apply and destroy.
